name: A Horse of Your Own
description: Oakhaven is bigger than it looks. Hana keeps the town herd.
intro: Welcome, welcome! You made it to Oakhaven in one piece.
Now — you'll wear out your boots in a week walking everywhere. Hana at the stables owes me a favour.
Go see her on the east side of the plaza. Tell her the mayor sent you.
outro: There you go — a natural! Well, mostly. Keep your heels down.
Ride with Z, and get off with Z. Ponies don't like fights or mine tunnels, mind.

steps.text: Talk to Stablemaster Hana (east of the plaza)
Press Z to ride your new pony

name: A Patch of Your Own
description: Every resident gets a homestead. Time to get your hands dirty.
intro: Now that you can ride — have you even seen your homestead yet?
South gate, then west along the Whispering Fields lane. Plant something. Anything.
When it's grown, show Farmer Rowan. He'll pretend not to be impressed.
outro: Hmph. A carrot. A real one, grown with your own hands.
Not bad for a beginner. Here — fertilizer. Mix it in before the next crop.

steps.text: Ride to your Homestead (south gate, then west along the lane)
Till, plant, water and harvest a Carrot (E on the soil)

name: Tools of the Trade
description: Farming feeds you. Mining pays for the tools.
intro: You'll want coin for better seeds — and copper's always selling.
Bram sells pickaxes up by the north road. Grab one and dig up some copper.
There's copper rock in the north meadow of Whispering Fields, if you don't fancy the mine yet.
outro: Five lumps of copper and all your fingers! Good start.
Now that ore's no use as rocks. Take it to Toren's furnace.

steps.text: Buy a Worn Pickaxe from Miner Bram (north Oakhaven)
Mine 5 Copper Ore (copper rocks in Whispering Fields's north meadow)

name: Fire and Metal
description: Ore becomes metal in the fire.
intro: Raw ore won't make a pickaxe. Raw ore won't make anything.
The furnace stands just east of Toren's smithy. Three ore, one bar.
Show Toren your first bar. He'll grumble. That means he likes it.
outro: …It'll do. Most people's first bar looks like a potato.
Here, a helmet. Mind your head out there — slimes have gotten bold.

steps.text: Smelt a Copper Bar at the furnace (east of the Blacksmith)

name: Slime Trouble
description: The slimes of Whispering Fields are eating the crops.
intro: Lina's been fretting. Slimes in Whispering Fields, chewing on everybody's cabbages.
You've a weapon. Use it. Press F near one — and don't let them surround you.
Five should send the message. Then tell the mayor.
outro: Five slimes! The farmers will sleep easier tonight.
Take these potions. Drink one when things get hairy — and they will.

steps.text: Defeat 5 Green Slimes in Whispering Fields's north meadow (F to attack)

name: Gone Fishing
description: A quieter skill — but just as valuable.
intro: You've earned some quiet. Olan fishes the pond in the south-east of town.
Buy a rod from him and catch anything at all. He'll teach you the rest.
outro: Ha! Look at that. First catch is always the best one.
Patience, timing, and a steady hand. That's all fishing is. That's all anything is.

steps.text: Buy a Bamboo Rod from Fisher Olan (pond, south-east Oakhaven)
Catch any fish (face water, E to cast, E on the bite, hold Space)

name: Goblins in the Fields
description: Goblins have made camp in the middle of Whispering Fields. Level 10+ recommended.
intro: Bad news from the south road. Goblins set up a camp past the old farm fields.
Get to level ten or so, then thin them out. The mayor will want to hear it's done.
outro: Eight goblins! Oakhaven owes you one.
The fields go much further south than most dare. Wolves, then worse. Talk to Kael at the castle.

steps.text: Defeat 8 Goblin Scouts (goblin camp, middle of Whispering Fields)

name: Howls in the South
description: Wolf packs roam the southern Whispering Fields. Level 20+ recommended.
intro: Kael at the castle wants fighters for the southern fields. Wolves, in packs.
They're no slimes. Level twenty, at least.
outro: Ten wolves. You've got steel in you.
There's something old under the fields too. If you've friends, Kael has a job for you.

name: The Mossy Crypt
description: Something old stirs beneath the fields. Level 12+ and a party recommended.
intro: The dead are walking in the old crypt under Whispering Fields.
Gather friends: a party shares the dungeon and the experience. Put Crypt Lord Varn back in his grave.
outro: Varn's down? Then the fields sleep easier tonight.
Keep what he dropped. And come back tomorrow: he never stays dead.

steps.text: Enter the Mossy Crypt (west side of Whispering Fields)
Defeat Crypt Lord Varn (the far chamber)

name: The Warden of the Fields
description: Gnarlfang guards the way to Master Aldric. Level 40, and bring friends.
intro: At the far south end of Whispering Fields an old wolf guards the way to Master Aldric's grove.
Aldric teaches the second jobs, but only to those who get past Gnarlfang. Level forty. Bring friends.
outro: You beat Gnarlfang? Then you have earned the right to choose.
Two paths for every class. Choose well: there is no going back.

steps.text: Defeat Gnarlfang, Warden of the Fields (the arena, far south)

name: The Desolate Crags
description: North of Oakhaven lie the Crags: ore, gems and living rock. Level 41+.
intro: Your new path needs better steel. North of Oakhaven lie the Desolate Crags.
Forgewarden Hal camps there. Earth elementals guard the ore.
outro: Ten of them? The rock will remember you.
Mine what you can. The best ore lies deeper still, in the ice.

steps.text: Defeat 10 Earth Elementals (Desolate Crags, north of Oakhaven)

name: Into the Glacial Depths
description: Rare ore and gems wait in the frozen caverns. Level 71+.
intro: Past the crags the mountain turns to ice. Scout Bjorna knows the way through the Glacial Depths.
Ice specters drift there. They don't like visitors.
outro: Eight specters! I'd have run.
Beyond the ice is Dragon's Peak. Only the strongest go there.

name: Dragon's Peak
description: Level 100 drakes and champions rule the summit.
intro: You're ready for the Peak. Kade the dragon hunter waits at the camp below the summit.
Everything up there is level one hundred. Everything.
outro: You lived. That's the first test.
There's one more. Beyond the peak burns the Infernal Caldera.

steps.text: Defeat 10 Young Drakes on Dragon's Peak

name: The Infernal Titan
description: Pyraxis waits in the Caldera. A raid of the realm's best is needed.
intro: Pyraxis, the Infernal Titan. He sleeps in the Caldera past the summit.
Gather a raid. Everyone who fights him gets their own share of the loot.
outro: The Titan fell! They'll sing about this in Oakhaven.
He'll rise again. They always do.

steps.text: Defeat Pyraxis in the Infernal Caldera

name: Pantry Raiders
description: Rats are eating the farmers' grain stores east of the road.
intro: The barns east of the road are crawling with rats.
Clear out eight of them and the farmers will sleep easier.
outro: Good riddance. The farmers asked me to pass this on.

steps.text: Defeat 8 Field Rats (east of the road)

name: Trampled Fields
description: Wild boars keep trampling Farmer Rowan's neighbours' crops.
intro: Boars! Big ones, west of the road. They flatten a field in a night.
Drive off six, then let Farmer Rowan know it's safe.
outro: Wren sent you? Bless you — my seedlings might survive the week.

steps.text: Tell Farmer Rowan the fields are safe

name: Orc Raiders
description: An orc warband has made camp in the south-west of the Fields.
intro: Orcs are camped in the south-west. They've been raiding the caravans.
Break their warband: ten should do it.
outro: Ha! They'll think twice before raiding my road again.

name: Webs in the East
description: Giant spiders are spinning webs across the eastern trails.
intro: Travellers keep vanishing on the east trail. Webs everywhere.
Burn out the nest — ten giant spiders.
outro: You came back without a single bite? Impressive.

name: The Restless Dead
description: Skeletons are rising near the Warden's grounds. The Guild should hear of it.
intro: Bones are walking near the southern ruins. That's never a good sign.
Put twelve back in the ground, then report to Guildmaster Kael.
outro: Skeletons, by the Warden's grounds? Then the old magic is waking. Well done.

steps.text: Report to Guildmaster Kael in Oakhaven

name: Dust and Daggers
description: Dust bandits are robbing the ore carts that feed Hal's forge.
intro: Bandits have been hitting my ore carts on the ridge.
Ten of them, and the rest will scatter.
outro: The carts are rolling again. Here — your cut.

name: Stone That Heals
description: Crag Shamans keep the elementals mended. Break their circle and bring Hal iron.
intro: Ever notice the elementals won't stay down? Shamans, mending them.
Take out six shamans — and bring me ten Iron Ore while you're out there.
outro: Good ore, and good work. The forge thanks you.

name: Living Rock
description: Rock Golems have blocked the north pass.
intro: The north pass is clogged with golems. The giants' ancient guards, some say.
Smash eight of them so the scouts can get through.
outro: The pass is open. The scouts are already on their way to the Depths.

name: The Cursed Watch
description: Wraiths and Cursed Knights haunt the old ruins at the top of the Crags.
intro: The old watch at the top of the Crags still keeps its post. Dead men, cursed armour.
Lay eight wraiths and eight knights to rest.
outro: Quiet up there at last. You've earned a forgewarden's respect.

name: Pack on the Slopes
description: Snow wolves are hunting the Guild's scouts on the lower slopes.
intro: The snow wolves have my scouts pinned. They charge fast — watch for it.
Ten wolves, and my people can move again.
outro: They're safe. I owe you one — no, I owe you several.

name: The Frozen Choir
description: Frost Priestesses keep the Depths' creatures alive. Silence them.
intro: Hear that singing? Frost Priestesses. Every song mends something you just broke.
Silence six of them.
outro: The singing's stopped. Eerie, but better.

name: Yeti Country
description: Yetis by the frozen lake are smashing the scouts' camps.
intro: Yetis have wrecked three of our camps by the lake.
Eight of them should teach the rest some manners.
outro: Not bad for a lowlander.

name: Ice and Iron
description: Glacier Warlocks summon wisps to guard the Frost Giant's brutes.
intro: Warlocks call wisps out of the ice. Kill the warlock and the wisps go with it.
Five warlocks — then six of the giant's brutes.
outro: The giant's guard is broken. He'll be lonely in his cave now.

name: Fire Faith
description: Dragon Priests heal the drakes as fast as Kade can wound them.
intro: Every drake I hurt, a priest patches up. Infuriating.
Six priests, then we hunt properly.
outro: Now we're hunting.

name: The Brood
description: Drake Broodmothers hatch wyrms faster than the Peak can hold them.
intro: Broodmothers. Each one calls hatchlings — and hatchlings explode.
Four broodmothers. Keep moving.
outro: The brood's thinning. You're good at this.

name: Knights of the Spire
description: Dragon Knights guard the way to the summit, led by their champions.
intro: The Dragon Knights swore themselves to the old wyrm. Ten of them, and three champions.
Then the summit's yours.
outro: The Spire's yours, hunter. The Guild will sing about this.

name: Imp Infestation
description: Fire imps are swarming out of the Caldera's vents.
intro: Imps. Dozens. They pour out of every vent.
Twelve should keep them busy for a day.
outro: Fewer squeaking, at least.

name: Hounds of Magma
description: Magma Hounds hunt in packs around the Titan's lair.
intro: The hounds circle the lair. They charge — don't stand in a line.
Ten hounds.
outro: Good. The Titan's pets are fewer.

name: Living Flame
description: Ember Elementals feed the Titan's fire. Put them out.
intro: Every elemental is a piece of the Titan's fire walking around.
Put out ten, and his flame burns lower.
outro: The fire's in its cage again. Thank you, champion.
